frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Security and Privacy Controls
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-53 is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright in the United States. Pack stores control IDs, official control titles, and baseline membership from the pinned OSCAL catalog.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 1,014 active controls and enhancements (20 families) are catalogued with LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/PRIVACY baseline tags. Identifier mappings and safeguard mappings are proposed until reviewed; this is catalog coverage, not an authorization.

frameworks.name: NIST Risk Management Framework (SP 800-37 Rev 2)
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-37 is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright in the United States. Pack stores the 47 RMF task identifiers and task statements.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 47 RMF tasks across the Prepare, Categorize, Select, Implement, Assess, Authorize, and Monitor steps are catalogued. RMF tasks are process evidence; mappings are proposed until reviewed.

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST CSF is public NIST guidance. Pack cites official CSF 2.0 function/category/subcategory IDs with short internal titles only.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 106 official Core outcomes are catalogued. Automated checks and proposed safeguard mappings provide limited evidence coverage; they do not establish full compliance.

frameworks.name: CMMC 2.0 Level 2 (NIST SP 800-171 alignment)
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 is public-domain U.S. government work. Pack stores official requirement IDs (3.x.y) and short internal titles only; CMMC assessment overlays ship separately.

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 (Protecting CUI in Nonfederal Systems)
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: NIST SP 800-171 is a U.S. Government work not subject to copyright in the United States. The pack stores requirement identifiers and official short titles only.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: All 97 Rev 3 security requirements across 17 families are catalogued from the pinned OSCAL catalog, each with its Rev 2 predecessors from NIST's r2-to-r3 change analysis. CMMC 2.0 Level 2 (cmmc-2-level2) stays on Rev 2. CCF mappings are proposed; 14 requirements have no CCF safeguard yet.
evidence_focus: Account, access, and authentication evidence for CUI systems
Configuration baselines, inventory, and change control
Incident response, supply chain risk, and system security plan
frameworks.next_step: Review the proposed mappings; add safeguards for the unmapped requirements listed in frameworks/packs/data/nist_800_171_rev3.json.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 Cloud security controls
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed. Pack stores clause identifiers and short internal titles only; customers must hold their own license for the official PDF.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy information management
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed. No controls are stored for the withdrawn 2019 edition.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: No controls seeded: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 was withdrawn when the 2025 edition was published on 2025-10-14; 2019 certificates remain valid until October 2028. Coverage lives on iso-27701-2025.
evidence_focus: Privacy information management scope and roles
PII processing inventory, purpose, and data-flow evidence
Privacy risk, data-subject rights, and supplier evidence
frameworks.next_step: Use iso-27701-2025. Seed 2019 identifiers only if an open source verifies them and a 2019-certified tenant needs them before October 2028.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2025 Privacy information management
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: ISO standard text is licensed; the pack stores Annex A identifiers and short titles only and links the official source. Customers must hold their own license for the standard.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: 10 of the 78 Annex A controls are seeded: those whose identifier and short title agree across two independent non-vendor sources (BSI and Schellman). The other 68 are listed as gaps in frameworks/packs/data/iso_27701_2025.json until a second source verifies them. Clauses 4-10 are not seeded.
evidence_focus: Cross-border transfer basis and disclosure records
Subprocessor register, notices, and temporary-file disposal
frameworks.next_step: Verify the remaining 68 Annex A identifiers against a second standards or certification body source, or a licensed copy, then seed them.

frameworks.name: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: EU legislation published in EUR-Lex may be reused with attribution. The pack stores article, paragraph and point identifiers with short paraphrased titles and cites the Official Journal text.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: 17 entity obligations are seeded: the Article 21(2)(a)-(j) cybersecurity risk-management measures and the Article 23(1), (2) and (4)(a)-(e) reporting obligations. Other articles, national transposition measures and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690 are not seeded.
evidence_focus: Risk analysis, security policies, and effectiveness assessment
Incident handling, business continuity, and supply chain security
Significant incident early warning, notification, and final report
frameworks.next_step: Review the proposed mappings; consider Article 20 governance and the Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690 sector requirements.

frameworks.name: DORA - Digital Operational Resilience Act (EU) 2022/2554
frameworks.copyright_guardrail: EU legislation published in EUR-Lex may be reused with attribution. The pack stores article, paragraph and point identifiers with short paraphrased titles and cites the Official Journal text.
frameworks.coverage_boundary: 99 financial-entity obligations are seeded at article or paragraph level: ICT risk management (Articles 5-14, 16), incident management and reporting (17-19), resilience testing (24-27), ICT third-party risk (28-30) and information sharing (45). Authority and ESA provisions are not seeded, nor are the regulatory technical standards.
evidence_focus: ICT risk management framework, asset inventory, and protection policies
Major ICT incident classification and reporting
Resilience testing, register of information, and ICT contract provisions
frameworks.next_step: Seed Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774 (RTS on the ICT risk management framework), pinned in the DORA manifest under related_acts.

frameworks.name: SOC 1 Type II (ICFR)

frameworks.copyright_guardrail: Do not reproduce licensed criteria text. Planned pack will cite official AICPA SOC 1 guidance with local control IDs only.

evidence_focus: ICFR scope and service-specific control objectives
